launch_vertex_jobs: launch jobs on Vertex AI by providing a name and sequence of xm.Job objects with container executables
create_vertex_client: create a Client instance for interacting with Vertex AI using a GCP project ID and location
run_vertex_job_status: run get_status on a VertexHandle to retrieve the current LocalWorkUnitStatus of a launched job
build_vertex_tensorboard: build or get a Vertex Tensorboard instance by name for job group logging and monitoring
convert_cpu_ram_to_machine: convert cpu and ram requirements into an optimal GCP machine type string for Vertex AI
